title: Weimar
description: The small Thuringian city of Goethe, Schiller and the Bauhaus, with a university of design and architecture and a music academy.
html:
A cultural capital in miniature

Weimar has 65,000 residents and a cultural weight out of proportion to its size. Goethe and Schiller lived and wrote here, the Bauhaus school of design was founded here in 1919, and the city's parks, museums and theatres draw visitors all year. The old town is compact and largely pedestrian.

Studying and working here

The Bauhaus University continues the design tradition with programmes in architecture, urbanism, design, media and civil engineering, several taught in English. A music academy adds to the creative population. Employment is concentrated in culture, tourism, education and the public sector; Erfurt and Jena are each 20 minutes away by train for a broader job market. Rents are moderate and the pace of life is calm.
